info.name: Get a genome assembly report by genome assembly accession

params.name: accessions
params.description: One or more genome assembly accessions, limited to 100

params.name: filters.reference_only
params.description: If true, limit to reference genome assemblies.

params.name: filters.assembly_source
params.description: Limit to either RefSeq (GCF_) or GenBank (GCA_) genome assemblies.

params.name: filters.has_annotation
params.description: Limit to annotated genome assemblies.

params.name: filters.exclude_paired_reports
params.description: If true, for GenBank (GCA_)/RefSeq (GCF_) pairs, returns the RefSeq copy. When no RefSeq copy exists, the GenBank assembly is returned.

params.name: filters.exclude_atypical
params.description: If true, exclude [atypical genome assemblies](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/docs/v2/data-processing/policies-annotation/genome-processing/genome_notes/#atypical-assemblies), i.e., genomes that have assembly issues or are otherwise atypical.

params.name: filters.assembly_version
params.description: Limit to the most recent (current) version of a genome assembly.

params.name: filters.assembly_level
params.description: Limit to genomes at the specified [assembly level](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/docs/v2/glossary/#assembly-level)

params.name: filters.first_release_date
params.description: Limit to genomes released on or after the specified date

params.name: filters.last_release_date
params.description: Limit to genomes released on or before the specified date

params.name: filters.search_text
params.description: Limit to genomes that match the specified submitter name, assembly name, infraspecific name (or modifier), or organism name.

params.name: filters.is_metagenome_derived
params.description: Exclude or limit to metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs).

params.name: filters.is_type_material
params.description: If true, limit to genomes derived from type material.

params.name: filters.is_ictv_exemplar
params.description: If true, limit to genomes derived from an ICTV exemplar (only applies to virus genomes).

params.name: filters.exclude_multi_isolate
params.description: If true, exclude genomes that were sequenced as part of large multi-isolate projects.

params.name: filters.type_material_category
params.description: Limit to genomes derived from specific type material categories.

params.name: returned_content
params.description: Return complete genome assembly reports, or abbreviated reports with assembly accessions with or without paired assembly information.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of genome assembly reports to return. Default is 20 and maximum is 1000. If the number of results exceeds the page size, `page_token` can be used to retrieve the remaining results.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A page token is returned when the results count exceeds `page size`. Use this token along with previous request parameters to retrieve the next page of results. When `page_token` is empty, all results have been retrieved.

params.name: include_tabular_header
params.description: Specify when to include the table header when requesting a tabular report.
